anomalies.observed: C14 is a 100 nF capacitor connected between the +3V3 power rail and NET0030, the ESP32-C6 IO1 / FLOAT_HIGH net that also drives the ATO-valve hardware interlock transistor T7.
anomalies.expected: A filter/decoupling capacitor on this signal should be connected to GND, as the corresponding FLOAT_LOW filter capacitor C42 is, or should not be present at all. A GPIO/sensor interlock net should not be AC-coupled to a power rail.
anomalies.impact: The FLOAT_HIGH/IO1 node is capacitively tied to +3V3 instead of ground. This can couple supply noise into the high-level water sensor input and alter float-switch transition timing, potentially causing false high-level detection or unintended disabling of the ATO valve through the T7 interlock path.

parsed.summary: The design files show an unintended 100 nF capacitor from +3V3 to the FLOAT_HIGH/IO1 net, unlike the matching FLOAT_LOW filter capacitor to ground; this signal-to-rail AC bridge can corrupt high-level water sensing and valve interlock behavior.
